description: Java class Renderer that formats bug reports into HTML using the ClearSilver JSilver templating engine. Contains methods for building hierarchical data structures (HDF) from bug report data, processes, threads, stack frames, logcat lines, and related information, and renders the output to a file.

classes.name: Renderer
classes.description: Class responsible for converting bug report data into HTML format using templates and hierarchical data structures.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main method to render a bug report into an HTML file.

methods.name: makeHdf
methods.description: Builds hierarchical data (HDF) structure from a Bugreport object.

methods.description: Builds HDF for an ANR (Application Not Responding) report.

methods.description: Builds HDF for VM traces, sorting processes by likelihood.

methods.name: makeTriageHdf
methods.description: Builds triage panel data, including main thread, deadlocked, and interesting processes.

methods.name: cloneAndFilter
methods.description: Clones process snapshots, filtering out already visited threads.
